segments.text: 大家好,今天我们评审一下新版设置页面的设计稿。
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 我先说一下,现在的设置像太多了,用户很难找到通知开关。
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 同意我们把通知相关的眩像放到第一屏,其他高级眩像折叠起来。
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 好这样改动不大,我下周二之前把新的交互稿发给大家。
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 另外深色模式,下一有几个按钮的对比度不够。
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 这个我也注意到了,你能不能整理一份需要调整的颜色清单?
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 可以我周四之前整理好颜色清单。
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 还有开发那边问我们什么时候能订搞?
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 我们订在下周五订搞。
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 订搞之后,请测试团队在两周内完成可用性测试。
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 好的,那就这么定了。
segments.speaker: S2

summary: 将通知相关设置放在第一屏，其他高级设置折叠。
深色模式下按钮对比度不足，需整理颜色清单。
开发订在下周五，两周后进行可用性测试。
decisions: 同意将通知相关设置放在第一屏，其他高级设置折叠。

segments.text: 我们开始这个sprint的planning吧,先看Bucklaw理优先级最高的三个ticket。
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 第一个是Login页面的bug,用户在password诛错之后,没有提示。
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 这个比较急,你今天能fix吗?
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 可以我今天下班之前fix这个bug,然后提交call review。
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 号第二个是Sir的performance,现在要等三秒多。
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 我觉得要加一个 Cash,不过需要后端同事一起看。
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 那我来约后端团队,这周三开个 Meeting 讨论 Cash 的方案。
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 第三个是 Onboarding 的新流程,Design 还没有发能。
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 那 Onboarding 我们放到下一个 Sprint,这个 Sprint 只做前两个。
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: OK 我同意,我会在周五之前更新 Sprint Board。
segments.speaker: S2

summary: 确定了优先处理的三个问题
安排了后端团队会议讨论Cash方案
decisions: 设计稿将在本周五之前更新Sprint板

segments.text: Morning, let's keep this short. The main topic is the mobile release that was planned for this Friday.
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: Right, the build is ready, but the offline sync still loses some changes when the network comes back.
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: How long do you need to fix that?
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: About two days, I will fix the offline sync bar and push a new build by Wednesday.
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: Okay, then we move the release from Friday to next Tuesday. Is everyone fine with that?
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: Yes, Tuesday works for me.
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: Good, that is decided. I will update the release notes and share them with the support team by Thursday.
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: Could you also ask the design team for the new pictures for the app store?
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: Sure, I will ask them today.
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: One more thing, the crash rate on older phones went up last week.
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: I would like the test team to run the full regression suite on the new build before Monday.
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: Agreed, let's meet again on Monday to confirm the release.
segments.speaker: S1

summary: The mobile release is moved from Friday to next Tuesday.
The offline sync issue is fixed by S2 within two days.
S2 asks the design team to provide new app store images.
decisions: The release date is changed to next Tuesday.

action_items.task: Move release date to next Tuesday
Update release notes and share with support team
Ask design team for new app store images
Run full regression suite on new build
